title: asplenium indicum var. obtusum
intro: Asplenium indicum var. obtusum, commonly known as Indian fern, is a plant species belonging to the family Aspleniaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Ayurvedic and Unani medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Indian fern include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing fever, relieving respiratory issues, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities.
